correctness.rationale: For Bessel F and closed-range K, K† is bounded and reconstruction of K†F through F is S_F(K†)*. Moore–Penrose identities (K†)*K*=P_R(K), K*(K†)*=P_{N(K)⊥} imply S_F(K†)*=K iff S_FP_R(K)=KK*. Direct one-point example H=C, K=I/2, F=1 has ∫|<f,F>|²=||f||² and ||K*f||²=||f||²/4, satisfying printed mixed A=B=1 frame inequalities, but reconstruction 2I≠I/2. Exact direct operator proof, no numerical dependency.
